text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...This one clocked a personal best in 
their final workout... And judging from 
the photos, their hindquarters look 
wonderfully toned."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
With a past victory at this racecourse and 
a pace-setting running style that matches 
this race... ...her position as the 
favorite is undeniably well-deserved.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even so...! This runner made a miraculous 
comeback from injury and is aiming for 
consecutive victories following last year—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Above all, word has it that this might be 
their final race...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Data? Or romance...?! No, if history is to 
choose—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, ah, Trainer...! Was I talking to 
myself too loudly?! I-I'm so sorry...!
